resource.isekai_mahou.mana.desc: Regenerates over time (much faster while meditating: crouched and still).
resource.isekai_mahou.vigor.desc: Regenerates slowly on its own. Fills when your fully charged melee hits land and when you take damage.
resource.isekai_mahou.focus.desc: Regenerates slowly on its own. Fills when your projectiles hit and while aiming crouched and still with a bow or crossbow.
screen.isekai_mahou.classes.category_hin: Pure spellcasters: rituals, grimoires and pacts. Resource: Mana.
glyph.isekai_mahou.strike.desc: Weapon form: your next melee hit (within 6 s) applies the effects to the target, with a glowing weapon. Split: +1 hit. Extend: more time.
glyph.isekai_mahou.arrow.desc: Weapon form: with a bow or crossbow, shoots a real arrow (uses 1 arrow) that applies the effects on hit. Without a bow, conjures a magic arrow. Split, Pierce, Ricochet and Homing apply.
glyph.isekai_mahou.stance.desc: Channel form: while you hold the key, the effects apply to you every 1 s (you walk at 60% and resist knockback). Costs resource every second.
glyph.isekai_mahou.parry.desc: Trigger: the slot fires by itself, aimed at the attacker, when you block with a shield or are hit in melee right after starting an attack (that damage drops by 25%).
glyph.isekai_mahou.guard.desc: Resistance for 5 s (Amplify: stronger; Extend: longer). Invert: breaks the enemy's guard (Weakness).
message.isekai_mahou.classes.stance_hold: ✦ Stance: %s — hold the key to keep it
message.isekai_mahou.classes.parry_react: Parry fires by itself: block with a shield or strike at the right moment.
screen.isekai_mahou.classes.category_hin: Blades, fists and battle-forged bodies. Weapon techniques (Strike, Stance, Parry) and a unique system per class. Resource: Vigor.
Precision, reflexes and luck: bows, bullets, cards and steel balls. The Arrow form shoots with magic. Resource: Focus.
screen.isekai_mahou.classes.multiclass: Free multiclassing: nothing stops you from learning other classes' things (scrolls, items and Lessons written by players of that class). Your class gives direction — affinity, kit, exclusive glyphs and a guide route — not a prison.
path.isekai_mahou.smith.desc: Hammer in one hand, rune in the other. The Smith doesn't find weapons: he FORGES them with magic — a dagger becomes a sword, the blade gains a curve, serrations, weight and shine, built like a glyph spell. Master of the furnace's Fire and the ore's Earth; Water cools his spirit.
path.isekai_mahou.smith.system.desc: Creates and CUSTOMIZES weapons with forge magic: length, width, curve, tip, serration, weight, grip, finish and rune — the weapon is assembled like glyphs. Inherits the path of blades: Field of Blades, Conjured Weapon and Arsenal Gate are Smith origin glyphs.
path.isekai_mahou.smith.bonus: Gear lasts much longer and repairs itself over time; weapons he forges hit harder.
path.isekai_mahou.rogue.desc: Nobody sees the Rogue coming — they only notice the empty pocket and the knife in the back. Steals items, mana, enchantments and even SPELLS (copying the caster's recipe), then vanishes into the shadows in one step. Shadow and Wind are his allies; Light gives him away.
path.isekai_mahou.rogue.system.desc: Pickpockets mobs, NPCs and players (with PvP), drains mana, rips off buffs and copies enemy spells into his own Grimoire. Shadow-steps behind the target and backstabs for ×2.5 damage.
path.isekai_mahou.rogue.bonus: High critical chance and double damage from behind.
path.isekai_mahou.knight.desc: Oath, steel and runes. The Rune Knight engraves magic into his own sword — every swing becomes a spell, every thrust fires a beam of light. Through worthy deeds he awakens legendary swords: the Sword of the Lake, Caliburn, the flaming blade, the storm sword. Light and Earth sustain him; Shadow corrodes him.
path.isekai_mahou.knight.system.desc: Engraves runes and whole spells into the blade (strikes trigger the spell), fires sword beams and awakens Legendary Magic Swords by completing feats.
path.isekai_mahou.knight.bonus: Extra armor while wielding a sword; steady against knockback.
path.isekai_mahou.enchanter.desc: A fighter who enchants himself and his allies: strength, speed, armor, regeneration, elements on a friend's weapon, party auras and overloads that stack up to a limit. His signature enchantments are legendary: ANTI-MAGIC — spells simply don't work on him — and HEAVENLY RESTRICTION, which trades all mana for an absurd body. True affinity with Light and Wind.
path.isekai_mahou.enchanter.system.desc: Buffs and upgrades on himself and ALLIES that stack up to a limit. Two mandatory origin enchantments, buildable and with levels: Anti-Magic (cancels or greatly reduces enemy spell damage and effects, but limits his own offensive spells and costs upkeep) and Heavenly Restriction (gives up mana and magic for absurd strength, speed, senses and toughness; invisible to magical detection, immune to sure-hit domains/barriers that target mana — and cannot cast while active).
path.isekai_mahou.enchanter.bonus: Enchantments last much longer and reach allies farther away.
path.isekai_mahou.shinigami.desc: A soul reaper whose sword has a name, a will and a soul of its own. Meditating, the Shinigami enters his Inner World to talk — and fight — with the blade's spirit. Sealed → Shikai → Bankai: Weight, Blade Petals, Ice, Ancestral Flame or the White Brush that erases the enemy's name. Kidō as glyphs. Shadow and Wind; Light repels him.
path.isekai_mahou.shinigami.system.desc: A spirit sword bound to the soul, with Sealed, Shikai and Bankai releases (the Shikai is chosen by archetype). Meditation leads to a personal dimension to talk and fight with the sword's spirit. Kidō (Hadō and Bakudō) as glyphs.
path.isekai_mahou.shinigami.bonus: Much stronger spiritual regeneration while meditating.
path.isekai_mahou.quincy.desc: A spirit hunter who turns the energy around him into arrows. Absorbs enemy projectiles and spells and returns everything as a storm of shots; forges energy swords, awakens a Letter and, in the Auswählen, absorbs the power of other Quincy to evolve. Light and Wind; Shadow weakens him.
path.isekai_mahou.quincy.system.desc: Spirit bow as a glyph form; absorbs energy, projectiles and spells and fires them back; energy swords (weaker); Letters (one chosen power); Auswählen: absorbs the power of nearby Quincy (Quincy NPCs and players who accept).
path.isekai_mahou.quincy.bonus: Absorbs part of the projectiles that hit him and turns them into Focus.
path.isekai_mahou.gunslinger.desc: Revolver in the holster, mana in the cylinder. The Gunslinger conjures his own guns — pistol, revolver, shotgun, rifle, dual pistols — and magic comes out through the bullets. Quick draw, charged shot, stylish reload: the arcane wild west in person. Fire and Wind run in his veins (and Lightning too); Water wets the powder.
path.isekai_mahou.gunslinger.system.desc: Creates magic guns made of mana; spells come out through the bullets (Bullet form and variations); reload, rapid fire and charged shots.
path.isekai_mahou.gunslinger.bonus: Faster reloads and bullets that cost less Focus.
path.isekai_mahou.ranger.desc: The classic archer of the trails, never alone: an eagle in the sky, a wolf at his side, a loyal horse. Companions grow with him, and every arrow is built like a spell — explosive, homing, chaining, piercing. Wind and Earth; Fire scares the woods.
path.isekai_mahou.ranger.system.desc: Companions (eagle, wolf, horse mount) that evolve; builds arrow effects as glyphs (explosive, homing, chaining, piercing...).
path.isekai_mahou.gambler.desc: Every spell is a bet: from −99% to +100% power. The Gambler throws energy-charged cards, spins roulettes, pulls the slot machine lever and rolls dice — and when it hits the JACKPOT, he enters infinite luck for a few seconds, with maxed regeneration and power. His domain? A Casino. Light and Shadow, both sides of the coin.
path.isekai_mahou.gambler.system.desc: Every spell rolls luck (from −99% to +100% power, with bands in between); jackpot = infinite luck for a few seconds (max regen and power); thrown cards, roulette, slot machine and dice; "Casino" domain.
path.isekai_mahou.gambler.bonus: Luck leans his way: better odds of high rolls.
path.isekai_mahou.steelball.desc: Steel balls thrown with a perfect spin, learned lesson by lesson from an old master. Across the world, Parts of the Holy Corpse lie hidden: each one awakens an Act of the spinning nail, up to the Infinite Rotation of Act 4. On horseback, he is unstoppable. Earth and Wind; Fire ruins the spin.
path.isekai_mahou.steelball.system.desc: Steel balls with spin; the master's lessons (a mentor NPC who teaches spins); Parts of the Holy Corpse hidden in structures evolve the power (Acts 1→4; Act 4 is infinite rotation); mounted bonus on horseback.
path.isekai_mahou.steelball.bonus: Stronger spin and much more power on horseback.
path.isekai_mahou.mage.system.desc: Observes the world's phenomena and completes theses at the Research Table; each thesis teaches Mage origin glyphs.
path.isekai_mahou.mage.bonus: Learns the four classical elements faster.
path.isekai_mahou.witch.system.desc: Brews rare recipes in the Ritual Cauldron, following the moon phases; each revelation opens new glyphs.
path.isekai_mahou.warlock.system.desc: Draws chalk circles and summons Patrons who demand tributes in exchange for power.
path.isekai_mahou.warlock.bonus: Shadow and Fire spells cost less.
path.isekai_mahou.druid.system.desc: Grows the Heart Tree of his Grove; each stage of the tree awakens new gifts of nature.
path.isekai_mahou.druid.bonus: Regenerates health and mana near nature.
path.isekai_mahou.necromancer.system.des: Harvests enemy souls and offers them at the Ossuary Altar at midnight; the rites raise ever stronger servants.
path.isekai_mahou.necromancer.bonus: Stronger servants and extra souls on kills.
